meta.about: Every tuning table the game runs on: G.config as the booted game holds it, plus the explosive rules and the enemy tuning resolved per difficulty. Web units throughout (metres, seconds, radians): convert lengths with x100 on the Unreal side.
meta.readFrom: the running web game (window.__G, three.js r160), every module real

units.web: metres, seconds, radians; +Y up, north = -Z, east = +X (right-handed)
units.ue: centimetres, degrees; +Z up, X = east, Y = south (left-handed)

meta.conversion: ue (X, Y, Z) = web (x, z, y) * 100; ue yaw = atan2(web z, web x) of a direction = -rotationY of a prop, in degrees

encoding.colours: a colour the game stores as a 0xRRGGBB number is written as "#rrggbb" (sRGB); [r, g, b] arrays are linear radiance and stay arrays
encoding.infinity: JSON has no Infinity: weapons.nine.reserve is the string "Infinity"
encoding.functions: a function in the tables is written as {"$function": {params, source, samples: [{args, value}]}}: the samples are what the running game answered, the source is the text of the function in src/config

settings.source: G.settings.all() in a clean browser profile (src/core/settings.js): the defaults a first-time player gets

hints.locked: Mouse is locked in. Esc lets it go.
hints.click: Click the street once to lock the mouse in.
hints.resume: Resume locks the mouse back in.
hints.drag: This browser won't lock the mouse: move it to look, rest it at a screen edge to keep turning. Click fires. Arrows or I J K L turn too.

args.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) Mobile/15E148

args.gpu: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Arc(TM) A770 Graphics, D3D11)

enemiesResolved.source: G.enemies.debug().tune after G.enemies.setDifficulty(G.config.enemies.difficulty[name]): the base tables with that difficulty laid over them, as the AI reads them

explosives.source: kinds: the rule row every placed explosive carries (G.explosives.items[n].kind). rules: module constants and formulas of src/explosives.js, imported in Node (they are not reachable from window.__G)
